subject: Post-call POC acceptance roadmap & scoring approach
content:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@medsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 17:12:00 -0500
Subject: Post-call POC acceptance roadmap & scoring approach

Hi Emma / Carlos —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the proposed acceptance roadmap for the 4-week POC and the scoring approach we discussed so the team can align before we lock dates. I attached a lightweight spreadsheet (POC acceptance checkpoints) and the Redwood POC playbook for reference.

Summary of proposed approach (high level):
- Objective: Validate MedSync’s routing & triage throughput on real traffic and measure answer quality for prioritized use cases (claims triage, provider lookup).
- Evaluation methods: staged approach — 1) Shadow (online) observation on live traffic for 10 business days, 2) Controlled offline batch scoring on a held-out set for 5 business days.
- Acceptance gates: Must meet both latency and quality thresholds. Quality measured by scored rubric below.
- Scoring rubric (proposal): 70% weight on correctness/accuracy, 20% on relevance/context (safety/PHI handling), 10% on latency SLO compliance. Threshold for pass = 80% aggregated score.
- Data & security: We will run in your VPC-peered sandbox; no PHI leaves your environment. PII/PHI handling checklist in playbook.
- Timeline (tentative): Kickoff week of Feb 1 -> shadow Feb 3–14 -> offline batch Feb 15–21 -> decision by Feb 25.
- Ownership: Tessa (project lead / Red), Marissa (evaluation lead / success metrics), Ben (infra/ops & integration).
- Next steps: Confirm timeline and the sample dataset for offline scoring (approx. 2k records), sign the SOW amendment for a 4-week POC.

Open questions for MedSync:
1) Can you commit to providing the offline sample dataset by Feb 8? (CSV with labels where available)
2) Do you have any hard blackout dates for the shadow window?
3) Any further internal compliance approvals required to run within your sandbox?

Thanks — feel free to edit the attached spreadsheet directly if you want tweaks to weights or acceptance thresholds.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: 20270118_POC-acceptance-checkpoints.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Tessa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. This aligns with our expectations; a couple of clarifying points: 

- On the scoring: the 70/20/10 split looks reasonable, but can you confirm if the correctness scoring is manual or partly automated? We will need to understand reviewer load.
- For PHI handling: we can provide an anonymized dataset for the offline batch, but for shadow we'll need confirmation that no tokenized PHI is persisted outside our VPC.
- Timeline: Feb 3–14 shadow window works for the ops team. We can deliver the sample dataset by Feb 8 if we agree on the schema today.

Also looping in Carlos (ops) to confirm there are no additional infra constraints on our side.

Best,
Emma
VP Product Operations | MedSync

To: Emma Li <emma.li@medsync.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@medsync.com>

Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 09:06:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post-call POC acceptance roadmap & scoring approach

Emma / Carlos —

Quick notes on the rubric and operational load:
- Correctness scoring: hybrid approach. We'll run an automated scorer for obvious matches (roughly 60% of cases) and surface ambiguous items for manual review by Marissa’s team. Expect manual review ~400–600 items across the offline batch depending on prevalence.
- Weighting tweak suggestion: propose moving 5% from latency to relevance (so 65/25/10) if you value context handling higher — happy to keep original if you prefer.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 400ms in shadow for production parity. We will surface breakdowns per model variant.
- Infra notes: We will instrument request-level traces and cost telemetry, but none of the logs will be ingested into Redwood’s hosted plane — everything stays in the VPC connection as discussed.

Proposed concrete schedule:
- Feb 1: Kickoff, integration checklist completed
- Feb 3: Start shadow (10 business days)
- Feb 16: Run offline batch scoring (5 business days)
- Feb 23: Internal scoring review and remediation window
- Feb 25: Decision and next-step meeting

Owners: Ben (integration + tracing), Marissa (grading + adjudication), Tessa (customer PM / decision facilitation).

I attached a draft scoring sheet (see POC acceptance checklist) with sample thresholds and a column for manual adjudication notes.

- Ben
Infra Lead | Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick turn. All good notes — Ben’s hybrid scoring plan sounds right to me. Confirming the minor weight tweak to 65/25/10 is acceptable unless you push back.

Action items we agreed on and owners:
- MedSync: finalize offline sample schema and deliver anonymized CSV by 2027-02-08 (Emma)

Thanks — excited to get this running.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
